instruction: A crocheted hedgehog worked in visible spiral single-crochet rounds, its back covered in dense loopy bobble stitches of variegated brown and caramel yarn. The face is smooth oatmeal yarn with a felted black nose bead, tiny embroidered smile and two shiny safety eyes. Four stubby yarn paws and rounded ears finish the palm-sized body.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Amigurumi Hedgehog in a knitted/amigurumi style. A crocheted hedgehog worked in visible spiral single-crochet rounds, its back covered in dense loopy bobble stitches of variegated brown and caramel yarn. The face is smooth oatmeal yarn with a felted black nose bead, tiny embroidered smile and two shiny safety eyes. Four stubby yarn paws and rounded ears finish the palm-sized body. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
